title: Credit Policy Decision Table Builder
description: Visual credit underwriting decision table builder. Define Approve/Decline/Refer/Counter-offer rules across FICO × DTI × LTV × Income dimensions, detect coverage gaps and rule conflicts, simulate applicant profiles, generate Reg B adverse action reasons, run Champion-Challenger policy comparisons, and export SR 11-7 policy documents and AP2 JSON mandates. Client-side. Zero PII.

approval_authority.description: Role label — not a personal name

mcp_tool_definition.name: build_credit_policy_decision_table
mcp_tool_definition.description: Author and validate credit underwriting decision tables mapping multi-dimensional inputs (FICO, DTI, LTV, Income) to Approve/Decline/Refer/Counter-offer outcomes. Detects coverage gaps and rule conflicts. Generates ECOA Reg B adverse action reason libraries formatted per CFPB Circular 2022-03. Produces SR 11-7 model governance documentation and Champion-Challenger comparison. Use when a credit policy team needs to author, review, or validate a lending decision policy.

regulatory_citations: CFPB Circular 2022-03 — adverse action notification requirements and AI/complex model specificity
SR 11-7 Model Risk Management Guidance (Federal Reserve)
EU Consumer Credit Directive 2 (CCD2) Article 18 — creditworthiness assessment
FCA CONC 5 — affordability and responsible lending
